wholePhysicalScope: The named seven-point footprint fixes the building at the Wellington Street and Aberdeen Street corner. The Town Planning Board confirms the address and records the ground and two upper commercial floors with six residential floors above.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the mixed-use corner identity and projecting green signs. Near levels add frontage glazing, orange fins, condensers and historic sign detail.
limitations: The model depicts the Wellington Street premises in May 2024, after reopening and before the May 2026 relocation to Sheung Wan.
Ground-floor thresholds and exact upper floor and parapet heights are approximated. The side wall uses a simplified color treatment, and the rear and roof equipment are generalised.
The café interior and adjoining buildings are outside the model scope. The Hong Kong DTM is an independent 5 m grid and supplies approximate sidewalk grades.
